label: Inheritance
source: A lump as the one line it adds: the amount arrives, into a taxable account or a retirement one.
confidenceNote: Your own figure; no tax is modelled on the way in.
note: Read by shared/blocks.js (D-178). `questions` are the block's four answers at most. Each `lines[]` entry is a DAITE delta: `path` must resolve under debt / assets / income / taxes / expenses; `delta` is an expression in the shared language (shared/expr.js): @answer, $household figure, {table} lookups. `when` (optional) is a condition that must hold for the line to exist. `source` is national unless `stateSource` resolves to a value for the answer's state, then state; `user` when the figure is the household's own. No expansion logic lives in a room.
